resources.title: Bacoor Government Center
resources.summary: Go to the City of Bacoor portal for city announcements, public documents, offices, and government information.

resources.title: Citizen’s Charter 2026
resources.summary: Open the current City of Bacoor Citizen’s Charter for documented services, requirements, processing steps, and office information.

resources.title: Bacoor One Stop Shop System
resources.summary: Continue to Bacoor’s online business portal for the transactions and account functions offered by that government system.

resources.title: Bacoor government office directory
resources.summary: Find department and office contact information published on the Bacoor Government Center directory page.
resources.source_title: Local Directories of Bacoor Government Center

resources.title: Barangay hall directory
resources.summary: Open the City of Bacoor’s published barangay hall directory for barangay names and available contact details.

resources.title: Hospital directory
resources.summary: View the hospital directory published by the City of Bacoor. Reconfirm urgent medical details directly before relying on them.

resources.title: Procurement notices
resources.summary: Browse procurement documents and notices published through the Bacoor Government Center procurement page.

resources.title: Full Disclosure Policy 2026
resources.summary: Open the City of Bacoor’s 2026 Full Disclosure Policy page for linked financial and governance documents.

resources.title: City departments & service contacts
resources.summary: Find published contact details for city departments, including civil registry, business permits, employment, social welfare, and health services.

resources.title: National government offices in Bacoor
resources.summary: Find the city-published directory of national government offices, including DTI, DILG, the post office, and the Public Attorney’s Office.

resources.title: Mayor’s working permit
resources.summary: Go to Bacoor’s official working-permit system to view the application options and instructions. Submit personal documents only on the government website.
resources.source_title: Bacoor City eGov — Online Mayor’s Working Permit

resources.title: Solidarity Route Pass
resources.summary: Access the city’s Solidarity Route Pass system for vehicle-pass applications, renewals, and application-status checks.
resources.source_page: SPass application and verification landing page

resources.title: City development plan 2026–2031
resources.summary: Read the city’s published Comprehensive Development Plan for 2026–2031 through its official document page.

resources.title: Jobs & career opportunities
resources.summary: Search DOLE’s national job portal for vacancies, job fairs, and training opportunities. Use its location search to find work in Bacoor or nearby areas.
resources.source_title: PhilJobNet — Department of Labor and Employment
resources.source_page: National jobs and labor market information portal

resources.title: Weather forecasts & advisories
resources.summary: Open PAGASA for official forecasts, rainfall information, and tropical cyclone advisories. Check the bulletin’s coverage and issue time for Cavite.
resources.source_page: Official weather portal; linked forecasts and advisories

resources.title: City announcements & advisories
resources.summary: Read announcements published by the City of Bacoor. Check each post’s date and coverage before making plans.
